purpose: Keyword, competitor and SEO/AEO/GEO implementation research for the approved website.
scope: Research only. No competitor contact, account change, publication or website edit.
evidence_policy: Priorities are qualitative recommendations based on supplied company services, location, buyer intent and observed official competitor content; no keyword-volume, CPC, difficulty or ranking measurements were available.
Competitors are a relevant comparison set, not a ranked or exhaustive market list. Their claims are self-descriptions from company-controlled sites, not independent certification checks.
Kuala Terengganu is the documented company location. Do not infer nationwide service coverage from historic jobs.
Retain approved visual composition; integrate search clarity through existing visible copy, metadata, links and structured data.
recommended_positioning: A construction and maintenance company based in Kuala Terengganu, with source-backed company credentials, documented historical experience and an ongoing project shown through genuine progress photography.

keyword_map.primary_en: construction and maintenance company Kuala Terengganu
keyword_map.primary_bm: syarikat pembinaan dan penyelenggaraan Kuala Terengganu
keyword_map.title: Akang Kasep | Construction & Maintenance, Kuala Terengganu
keyword_map.description: Akang Kasep Sdn. Bhd. is a construction and maintenance company based in Kuala Terengganu. Explore our services, credentials and project experience.
keyword_map.placement: Keep the approved hero headline. Use the locality and core service phrase in the introductory paragraph and page title; do not force all variants into the hero.

keyword_map.title: About Akang Kasep | Kuala Terengganu Construction Company
keyword_map.description: Learn about Akang Kasep's company background, people, construction and maintenance focus, and corporate information in Kuala Terengganu.
keyword_map.placement: Use consistent legal name and registration number, genuine history and clear business/contact facts. Keep historical project entries on Projects.

keyword_map.title: Construction & Maintenance Services | Akang Kasep
keyword_map.description: Explore Akang Kasep's construction and maintenance services, including building works and coordinated project scopes. Discuss your project requirements.
keyword_map.placement: Use precise service headings and concise scope descriptions. Civil/external and selected M&E descriptions must stay within approved scopes; registration categories alone do not establish every currently offered service.

keyword_map.title: Construction & Maintenance Projects | Akang Kasep
keyword_map.description: View Akang Kasep's ongoing project photographs and selected experience in quarters maintenance and specialist kitchen, ventilation and LPG works.
keyword_map.placement: Show exact client, scope, value and labelled profile date for historical entries; ongoing Project A retains its working-title and Ongoing labels. Do not use unrelated photos for historic contracts.

keyword_map.title: Contact Akang Kasep | Kuala Terengganu
keyword_map.description: Contact Akang Kasep Sdn. Bhd. in Kuala Terengganu to discuss construction or maintenance requirements. Find our office, telephone and enquiry details.
keyword_map.placement: Keep address, email and phone consistent with approved current copy. No invented office hours, WhatsApp capability, response-time promise or service-area map.

keyword_map.title: Company Credentials & Registration | Akang Kasep
keyword_map.description: Review company registration and credential information documented in Akang Kasep's profile, including CIDB, SPKK, STB, MOF and SCORE details.
keyword_map.placement: Label document dates and expiry details accurately, expose only public-safe information, and do not imply a live registry check.

keyword_exclusions.reason: The supplied profile does not establish those specific current offers.
No verified source for availability, geographic coverage or ISO certification.
Historical specialist project evidence exists, but current saleable service scope/licensing needs confirmation before targeting as an active standalone offer.

competitors.name: WAA BINA (M) SDN. BHD.
competitors.verified_from_official_site: Kuala Terengganu address; describes civil/building construction, road and general maintenance work and G7 registration.
competitors.content_observation: Navigation separates services, projects, organisation, machinery and certifications.
competitors.inferred_opportunity: Make Akang Kasep's construction-to-maintenance proposition and documented progress easy to understand in a similarly verifiable but visually distinct presentation.

competitors.name: GPQ Sdn. Bhd.
competitors.verified_from_official_site: Kuala Terengganu contact address; identifies itself as a Terengganu Incorporated subsidiary and G7 contractor with building, housing, highway and infrastructure experience.
competitors.content_observation: Provides corporate history, regional project scope and clear group/business context.
competitors.inferred_opportunity: Use Akang Kasep's own named experience and practical service scope rather than trying to claim the same group scale or breadth.
competitors.limitations: A benchmark with a different corporate scale; not proof the companies compete for identical tenders.

competitors.name: Building Lindungan Sdn. Bhd.
competitors.verified_from_official_site: Describes building/facilities maintenance involving Kelantan, Terengganu and Pahang, with engineering, security, landscape, cleaning and pest-control functions; listed office in Kota Bharu.
competitors.content_observation: Explains maintenance scope and has a list-of-buildings navigation item.
competitors.inferred_opportunity: Give maintenance equal visibility to construction and use the documented Putrajaya quarters contract as specific experience.
competitors.limitations: Its page mentions an extension only through March 2026; do not repeat that as a presently active contract.

competitors.name: AMJ Technique Sdn. Bhd.
competitors.verified_from_official_site: States it was established in Kemaman; service list includes civil building maintenance, structure/piping fabrication, installation/welding and tank work.
competitors.content_observation: Uses a direct service list with a company-profile link.
competitors.inferred_opportunity: Explain the actual boundaries of Akang Kasep's services clearly, without copying unrelated industrial capabilities.
competitors.limitations: Indexed and opened versions showed differing contact details, so no contact address or phone is reproduced here; service positioning only.

implementation.action: Render the main company, service and project copy as crawlable HTML. Use a unique descriptive title and meta description per page, a coherent H1/H2 outline and crawlable internal links.

Use one canonical public host and clean extensionless routes. Redirect obsolete .html paths, publish a sitemap of actual indexable URLs and return real 404 status for unknown pages. The final production host must be configured; do not ship example.com canonicals.

Add accurate Organization JSON-LD with legal name, logo, registration identifier, address and contact details. Add BreadcrumbList on interior pages. Markup must match visible content; omit invented sameAs profiles, aggregate ratings, geo coordinates, office hours and coverage areas.
Use original, relevant project imagery with descriptive alt text and captions; decorative shapes use empty alt text or CSS. Keep important headings and copy out of image-only artwork.

Answer buyer questions clearly within existing approved sections: what the company does, where it is based, how to enquire, what experience is documented and how project progress is shown. Preserve the design instead of adding keyword-stuffed blocks.

Keep body copy and controls readable across large desktop, tablet and phone; support keyboard navigation, reduced motion, stable layouts and fast images. This is a usability requirement as well as search groundwork.

After deployment, verify the real domain in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, submit the sitemap and check crawl/index eligibility. Review the current Search Console generative-AI inclusion setting referenced by Google's newer guidance. No account setup performed in this research.
Keep Google Business Profile and Bing Places facts consistent with the published site if the owner manages those profiles. Do not invent profile links or opening hours.
Measure enquiries, search impressions/clicks and available AI-citation reports separately. A citation is not a site visit or a qualified enquiry.
Use English for the approved English design. The BM keyword map supports a later complete, accurate Malay version; add hreflang only when real equivalent translated URLs exist.

avoid: No rankings, traffic, leads or AI-citation guarantees.
No meta-keywords tag as a claimed Google ranking tactic.
No hidden keyword text, copied competitor copy, location doorway pages or unsupported service claims.
No requirement to add llms.txt or special AI schema for Google visibility.
No blanket promise of FAQ rich results; the previously documented FAQ page redirected to Google's updates page during this research.
Do not call source-based qualitative keyword prioritization measured keyword research.
